selection.rule: Use the repository's predeclared channel-separated holdout; do not select from ticket #114 outcomes.

bounds.failurePolicy: Stop the single test process and reject the evidence if either bound is exceeded, the input preflight fails, SpeakerKit does not unload, or another heavy model starts.

preflightAfterSlot: Verify Sources and Tests at HEAD match implementation.commitSHA and the worktree is clean.
Verify manifest and source SHA-256 plus source sample count before SpeakerKit loads.
Verify the local model cache contains only the declared SpeakerKit runtime assets needed by W8A16.
Stop this worktree's app process so no second model is resident.

exposeBetaDescription: The test passes under the frozen command and bounds.
At least one suggestion is useful against the reference.
suggestionCount equals usefulSuggestionCount and falseSuggestionCount is zero.
Model provenance and thresholds exactly match the frozen contract.
SpeakerKit unload completes and no test process remains.
decisionGates.otherwise: Keep the UI absent and report the holdout result without changing thresholds or algorithm.

claimLimits: Precision is prioritized. The holdout decides only whether to expose the advisory Bêta description; it does not support a recall or Standard-promotion claim.
